title: Siłownia · aspekt
note: Gym idiom (a1_case_gym / a2_past_gym line): ZERO new material — teaches_structures and teaches_lemmas both empty. Drills the full four-way grid the learner now owns: kupowałem (past activity/habit) / kupiłem (past, once, finished) / będę kupować (future activity/repeated) / kupię (future, once, finished) — past and future MIXED, time-word and result cues in English, Polish only in frames and answers. The four-way is complete only for the four twins (kupować/kupić, robić/zrobić, pić/wypić, czytać/przeczytać), so the gym stays inside them. MATCH is three complete four-ways (buy·I-m, read·she, drink·he) = 12 rows, so the whole-board reveal IS the grid. QUIZ is 12 discrimination items, each demanding one cell against distractors from the other cells; PISANIE is the 12-cell production core; UŻYCIE is 12 sentences with noun subjects/objects, one per cell across the verbs. POOL: POOL_b1_early.md (end of b1_perf_future) — strictly earlier than this node's path slot; the two intervening nodes teach no grammar forms (b1_two_futures = pure discrimination by design, b1_plans = vocab), so the pool is conservative and safe. FORM FENCE, every demanded and distractor form checked against the pool: AVOIDED as never taught — kupowałeś/kupowałaś/kupowało, kupiłeś/kupiłaś/kupiło, zrobiłeś/zrobiłaś/zrobiło, przeczytałeś/przeczytałaś, czytałaś, wypiło. USED past forms are exactly the pooled set: kupowałem/kupował, kupiłem/kupił/kupiła, robił/robiła, zrobił/zrobiła, pił/piła/piłam/piłem, wypił/wypiłam, czytał/czytała/czytałam/czytałem, przeczytał/przeczytała/przeczytałam/przeczytałem; futures are the 24 b1_perf_future forms plus a2_bedzie's helpers + pooled infinitives. B1 FENCES: no conditional; no oni/one anywhere (the only plural tasks are my/będziemy forms or noun subjects — none needed 3pl pronouns); no vocative; no new perfective verbs. GLOSSES: per B1-SPINE post-b1_two_futures rule, every future gloss distinguishes 'will buy it (once, finished)' from 'will be buying'; past dynamic verbs keep 'was buying / used to buy' per AGENTS. TIME WORDS verified in pool: zawsze, często, czasami, codziennie (now pooled — it was not at a2_aspect time), wczoraj, jutro, rano, dziś wieczorem, w weekend. HOMOGRAPHS: recycled objects kawę/herbatę/książkę/zupę are taught accusatives used as accusatives; chleb/obiad/piwo/list/wszystko inanimate nom=acc, same reading. FORK LOGGED: b1_two_futures.json did not exist yet when this gym was authored (parallel batch), so the decision-rule language (habit words → imperfective, jutro+result → kupię, repeated future → będę kupować) follows the spine's own examples rather than quoting that unit; no contradiction is possible because this gym asserts nothing new. FORK LOGGED: intro slide 3 shows the 4×4 he-form grid — all 16 cells pool-verified; będzie kupować / będzie robić appear there and in tasks as legal a2_bedzie assemblies.

intro.title: Nothing new — the whole grid is yours
intro.title_pl: Nic nowego — cała siatka jest twoja
intro.body:
Four forms of to buy, and you already own every one of them. Two questions pick the right cell, every time.

First: past or future? Second: the activity — ongoing or repeated — or one finished action with a result?

Answer both and the form chooses itself. This unit only trains the choosing, at speed.
intro.body_pl: Dwa pytania: przeszłość czy przyszłość? Czynność czy wynik?

rows: I was buying · I used to buy
past — the activity, or a habit

intro.title: The time words decide
intro.body:
You rarely have to think hard — the words around the verb usually make the choice for you.

Habit words point at the imperfective twin, whichever direction time runs. One occasion plus a result points at the perfective twin. And as before: when you truly cannot decide, take the imperfective — it only claims the activity happened, which is nearly always true.
intro.body_pl: zawsze · często · czasami · codziennie → niedokonany. Jedna skończona sprawa → dokonany.

rows: zawsze · często · czasami · codziennie — a habit, in the past
a future activity or habit — no finish promised

intro.title: All four verbs, all four cells
intro.body: Here is the whole board, shown on the he-forms. Read across a row and you can hear the system: same pair of verbs, past on the left, future on the right, activity above result — sixteen cells and not one of them is new.
intro.body_pl: Szesnaście pól — i żadne nie jest nowe.

quiz.prompt: Codziennie ___ kawę. · I used to drink — a woman speaking
quiz.explain: codziennie is a habit word and the drinking is behind you — past plus imperfective: piłam. wypiłam would report one finished cup; wypiję and będę pić point forwards.

quiz.prompt: Jutro ___ chleb. · I will buy it — once, done
quiz.explain: One trip, bread in the bag — perfective future. będę kupować would promise a repeated activity, and kupuję means I am buying it right now.

quiz.prompt: Codziennie ___ chleb. · I will be buying — every day from now on
quiz.explain: A repeated future has no single finish, so it takes będę plus the activity verb. kupię would name one purchase, done once.

quiz.prompt: Wczoraj mama ___ zupę. · made it — it was ready
quiz.explain: The soup was ready — a result, so the perfective zrobić; and wczoraj keeps it in the past: zrobiła, not zrobi.

quiz.prompt: Mama często ___ obiad. · used to make
quiz.explain: często means many occasions, and a habit takes the imperfective. zrobiła would point at one finished lunch.

quiz.prompt: Jutro mama ___ obiad. · will make it — once, finished
quiz.explain: jutro plus one finished lunch — the perfective future zrobi. będzie robić would leave the cooking open-ended, with no lunch promised.
wszystko is a finished amount — nothing left — so wypić; and it already happened, so the past form wypił.

quiz.prompt: Dziś wieczorem tata ___ piwo. · will be drinking — the evening activity
quiz.explain: The gloss claims only the activity — an evening with a beer, no promise the glass ends empty. wypije would make that extra claim.
jutro and a past form contradict each other. Keep jutro and keep the whole-book claim: przeczytam.

quiz.prompt: Zawsze ___ chleb w sklepie. · I used to buy — a man speaking
quiz.explain: zawsze is habit territory and the habit is in the past — the imperfective past kupowałem, exactly as in the aspect unit.

quiz.prompt: W weekend ___ książkę. · we will read it all
quiz.explain: Read it all — to the end — is the perfective claim, so przeczytamy. będziemy czytać only promises time with the book.

quiz.prompt: Dziś wieczorem ___ książkę. · I will be reading — no promise to finish
quiz.explain: No finish promised — the activity future, będę czytać. przeczytam would commit you to the last page tonight.

type_items.explain: Helper plus the activity verb — and no gender to choose, whoever is speaking.
Not kupuję — that means now. The one-word future is built on kupić's own stem: kupi- + ę.
The past chose between zrobił and zrobiła; the future does not — zrobi covers he and she alike.
No tail on the -e: wypije is he or she. wypiję with the tail would put you in the sentence.

use_items.explain: często — many pots over many days — keeps the verb imperfective. zrobiła would name one finished pot.

use_items.prompt_en: Type: Tomorrow Mum will make lunch.
Type: Yesterday I bought the bread. (m)
Type: Tomorrow I will buy the coffee.
use_items.explain: One purchase, done — kupię. And whether a man or a woman says it, the form is the same: the gender choice stayed behind in the past.

use_items.prompt_en: Type: I will be buying bread every day.
use_items.explain: every day makes it a repeated future — będę plus the activity verb. Jutro kupię would be one loaf, once.

use_items.prompt_en: Type: Yesterday Dad drank the beer up.
Type: Tomorrow morning Dad will drink the coffee up.
Type: Anna will be drinking tea.
use_items.explain: Only the activity is claimed — tea-drinking, no empty cup promised — so będzie plus pić, not wypije.

use_items.prompt_en: Type: Yesterday I read the whole book. (f)
Type: At the weekend my brother will read the whole letter.
use_items.answer: W weekend mój brat przeczyta list.
accepts: W weekend mój brat przeczyta list.
W weekend mój brat przeczyta list
Mój brat przeczyta list w weekend.
Mój brat przeczyta list w weekend

use_items.prompt_en: Type: This evening I will be reading a book.
use_items.explain: An evening with the book, no last-page promise — będę czytać. przeczytam would commit you to finishing it tonight.
